newsitem.title: USA: Stage Stores Nov-Dec same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Stage Stores Nov-Dec same-store sales rise.

text.p: Stage Stores Inc said 1996 sales for the nine weeks ended January 4 increased 16.8 percent to $209 million from $178.9 million a year ago, while same-store sales increased three percent.
The company said year-to-date sales for the forty-eight weeks ended January 4 increased 15.6 percent to $737.5 million, while same-store sales increased 3.5 percent.

"Despite the five fewer shopping days during the holiday season, we are very pleased to report solid gains during this period which exceed expectations," commented chief executive Carl Tooker. "We believe our strong holiday results validate our merchandising strategy, and we are on track to achieving our earnings objectives for fiscal 1996."
Stage Stores operates 320 department stores in 20 states across the central U.S. under the names Stage, Bealls, and Palais Royal.
